description: This is a shell script that automates the setup, building, testing, and coverage reporting for a C++ project involving AppGateway, Thunder, entservices-apis, and dependencies like googletest. It includes repository cloning, patch application, building components with CMake, staging plugin shared libraries, executing tests, and generating coverage reports.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Ensures a git repository is checked out at a specific ref/tag.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repo if not present, or rechecks out to a specific ref/tag.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory idempotently.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if CMake cache exists in build directory, indicating configuration.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a component is installed in a prefix.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component using CMake.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a component with CMake without installing.

methods.name: stage_plugin_so_from_glob
methods.description: Stages a plugin shared object from a glob pattern.

methods.name: stage_all_plugins_from_dir_best_effort
methods.description: Stages all plugin shared objects from a directory.

methods.name: stage_plugin_with_expected_name
methods.description: Stages a plugin shared object with an expected filename.
